hooks.command: unset CDPATH; input=$(cat); root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; common_dir() { cd "$1" && cd "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)" && pwd -P; }; cwd=$(printf '%s\n' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null); cwd_root=$(cd "${cwd:-.}" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ "$(common_dir "$cwd_root")" = "$(common_dir "$root")" ] && root=$cwd_root; [ -x "$root/scripts/hooks/before-tool" ] || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$input" | "$root/scripts/hooks/before-tool"
